n313a761f38.headline: Vehicle insurance premiums rose up to 32% in the last year
n313a761f38.summary: Vehicle insurance premiums in San Juan have increased by up to 32% over the last year, varying by coverage type and vehicle value.
n313a761f38.why: Rising insurance premiums affect consumer costs and can influence automotive market demand and financial sector profitability.
